ft.step1: Patient sits upright, forearm resting, hand raised to shoulder height.
ft.step2: Tap index finger against thumb, as wide and as fast as possible.
ft.step3: Keep tapping until the recording stops by itself.

ftf.step1: Patient sits facing the camera with both arms free.
ftf.step2: Stretch the arms out, then bring the index fingertips together in front of the chest.
ftf.step3: Repeat until the recording stops by itself.

fr.step1: Patient sits facing the camera, elbow bent, forearm forward.
fr.step2: Turn the forearm palm-up and palm-down, as wide and fast as possible.
fr.step3: Keep going until the recording stops by itself.

saw.step1: Patient sits on the chair at the start mark, side-on to the camera.
saw.step2: Stand up without using the arms.
saw.step3: Walk to the 5 m mark, turn around and walk back.
saw.step4: Sit down again. The recording stops by itself.

fa.step1: Patient looks straight at the camera, face fully visible.
fa.step2: Follow the spoken prompts for each expression.

hint.hand_outline: Place the hand inside the outline
hint.upper_body: Fit head, shoulders and both arms inside the outline
hint.full_body: Seat the patient inside the start box, side-on
hint.face_oval: Fit the face inside the oval
